spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Which site serves each workload, and what recovery evidence is missing?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/wsl/multi-site.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Expected sites
spec.description:
Declared inventory survives the disappearance of a source. This is expected scope, not health.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Reporting sites
spec.description:
Distinct selected sites with fresh, successful evidence. Duplicate observations count once. Compare with Expected sites; partial results never certify fleet health.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Site evidence
spec.description:
Measured site evidence, including explicit Unknown when an expected site stops reporting. Independent site probes distinguish unreachable from unobserved.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Evidence age
spec.description:
Age of the last successful Kubernetes inventory observation. A recent Prometheus scrape alone does not prove the collector is seeing its upstream.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Ready nodes
spec.description:
Ready nodes per Kubernetes cluster. These nested Talos nodes share the Windows/WSL host's physical CPU, RAM and disk.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Cross-site observation
spec.description:
Fresh bounded probes from one site to the other. Observer identity is retained; this is connectivity evidence, not the remote site's internal condition.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Workload state
spec.description:
Per app and site, from replica counts: ready, degraded, failed, or a deliberate standby at zero replicas. A site that stops reporting shows Unknown.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Declared placement

spec.expr: max by (k8s_cluster, app, tier, kind, workload) (homelab_expected_workload_info{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"})

spec.description:
Expected app/site/tier inventory independent of discovery. Standbys and hardware-pinned applications remain visible.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Desired replicas
spec.description:
Effective workload desired replicas from the local Kubernetes API, separate from git's default placement.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Ready replicas
spec.description:
Observed readiness. Ready replicas do not prove the global ingress is serving this site.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Runtime overrides present
spec.description:
Presence of flux-system/site-overrides. Raw contents and secret-like values are never exposed.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Override creation age
spec.description:
Age of creation, not last modification. Consult structured operation events for when a particular override changed.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Readiness evidence
spec.description:
Unknown is retained whenever fencing, backup or restore evidence is absent. This is not a safe-to-promote guarantee.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Fencing evidence age
spec.description:
Present only for verified fence evidence. DNS ownership alone cannot establish that the former primary is unable to write.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Fence job age
spec.description:
Last successful fleet fence Job. It may succeed with unreadable leases, so this never establishes per-app fencing.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Lease authority reachable
spec.description:
The current TXT lookup returned a recognized site or none. Reachability does not prove a former primary was fenced.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Lease blocks this site
spec.description:
One means the lease prohibits this site from serving the app. Zero alone cannot authorize promotion.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Last restore evidence
spec.description:
Per-app restore evidence, not one successful fleet CronJob. Missing per-app results remain Unknown.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
